message.content:
The first risk is that supply chain constraints cap the conversion of demand into revenue, a limit management describes as the governor of near-term revenue [D3]. That risk would be confirmed by fourth quarter revenue landing below the low end of the guided range of 1.93 billion to 1.95 billion dollars [D1].

The second risk is that the one-time tariff impacts that lifted fiscal 2026 profitability do not repeat, leaving a higher comparison bar for margins in later periods [D3]. That risk would be confirmed by gross margin in a quarter after the fourth falling below the 65.87% recorded in the latest quarter [D1].

The third risk is that the AI infrastructure demand behind record wireline orders proves less durable than the base case management described, exposing the Communications Solutions Group to a pause in hyperscale capital spending [D3]. That risk would be confirmed by Communications Solutions Group revenue growth in a later quarter falling below the 43.09% recorded in the latest quarter [D1].

The fourth risk is that integration of recent acquisitions, including Spirent, does not deliver the cost synergies management expects on a run rate basis exiting the fiscal year [D3]. That risk would be confirmed by operating income growth for the total segments in a later quarter falling below the 81.36% recorded in the latest quarter [D1].
